notes.text: Jerome, also known as Jerome of Stridon, was an early Christian priest, confessor, theologian, translator, and historian; he is commonly known as Saint Jerome.
Jerome is remembered as a religious figure connected with Serbia.
Jerome's recorded life dates place this profile around 345-420.
Jerome is grouped with Philosophy, Ethics & Religion in the People Library.
Jerome's profile connects a short Fact to a wider Serbia historical setting.
